svg.title: whoami: Abhishek Kumawat
svg.desc: Terminal panel introducing Abhishek Kumawat, full-stack and AI engineer, B.Tech at IIT Patna.

g.text: Full-stack developer who turns hard problems into
products people actually use. I live in the MERN
world but reach for whatever ships the best result:
real-time systems, AI-driven apps and data platforms.
